name: University of Bern
summary: Full university in Switzerland's federal city; bachelor's degrees are taught in German, and non-native speakers prove German at C1.

handoff.label: Bachelor's admission with an international certificate

ib.text: 32/42 points, six subjects in the swissuniversities pattern, three at HL including maths or a science (2026/27 rules). German C1 certificate, or pass Bern's German test just before term.

notes: For 2026/27 the bachelor's deadline was 30 April, with late applications to 31 August unless you need a visa; the 2027/28 rules are not yet out.
Bern's own German test is held about three weeks before the autumn semester, and you must register for it by 31 July; you enrol only once you pass.
Medicine, Dental and Veterinary Medicine close earlier, on 15 February in 2026/27, and may use an aptitude test in early July.
